rules.title: High-impact permission requested
rules.summary: The extension requests one or more permissions that grant powerful capabilities.
rules.whyItMatters: High-impact permissions can expose sensitive browser data or powerful control to the extension.
rules.recommendation: Review whether the extension's described purpose plausibly needs this capability.

rules.title: Potentially unused permission
rules.summary: A declared permission has no matching API usage detected in static analysis.
rules.whyItMatters: Requested-but-unused capabilities widen the extension's attack surface beyond what its code appears to need.
rules.recommendation: Static detection may miss dynamically referenced APIs; verify manually before acting.

rules.title: Powerful optional permission available
rules.summary: The extension declares high-impact optional permissions that can be granted later at runtime.
rules.whyItMatters: Capabilities can expand after installation without a new install review.
rules.recommendation: Watch for unexpected permission prompts while using this extension.

rules.title: Broad host access
rules.summary: The extension can potentially interact with pages on all websites.
rules.whyItMatters: Broad host access allows the extension to interact with content across a very wide set of websites, including sensitive ones.
rules.recommendation: Verify the extension's purpose justifies broad access. Prefer limited sites where the publisher offers it.

rules.title: Local file access requested
rules.summary: Host permissions include file:// scheme access.
rules.whyItMatters: Access to the file scheme can expose local documents to the extension when file access is enabled in Chrome.
rules.recommendation: Confirm this capability is required for the extension's purpose.

rules.title: Plain HTTP host pattern
rules.summary: A host permission matches non-encrypted http:// origins.
rules.whyItMatters: Interacting over plain HTTP exposes traffic to interception.
rules.recommendation: Confirm the target site offers HTTPS and the pattern is intentional.

rules.title: Host pattern covering sensitive domains
rules.summary: Host patterns match domains commonly associated with accounts, mail or payments.
rules.whyItMatters: Content or credentials on sensitive sites could become accessible to the extension.
rules.recommendation: Review whether this scope is required for the extension's purpose.

rules.title: Content scripts injected on all sites at document start
rules.summary: Content scripts match all URLs and run early in page load.
rules.whyItMatters: Early, broad content-script injection means the extension's code runs on every page the user visits.
rules.recommendation: Verify the extension's purpose requires running on every page.

rules.title: Content scripts run in all frames
rules.summary: Content scripts are declared with all_frames: true.
rules.whyItMatters: The scripts also run inside iframes, multiplying execution contexts and potential interaction surfaces.
rules.recommendation: Confirm frame-wide injection is intentional.

rules.title: Native messaging requested
rules.summary: The extension can communicate with an installed native application.
rules.whyItMatters: Native messaging is a powerful local capability that bridges the extension to a desktop program with the user's privileges.
rules.recommendation: Identify which native application is being contacted and whether you trust it.

rules.title: Dynamic code execution pattern detected
rules.summary: Source contains string-to-code execution such as eval() or new Function().
rules.whyItMatters: Dynamic code execution can make behavior depend on data rather than reviewable source code.
rules.recommendation: Determine what data flows into these calls. Context could not be fully determined statically.

rules.title: Potential DOM injection surface
rules.summary: HTML-assigning sinks (innerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write) receive data that could be influenced by page content or network responses.
rules.whyItMatters: Injecting unsanitized strings into the DOM can lead to script execution in the extension or page context.
rules.recommendation: Review whether the assigned data is static or derived from untrusted sources.

rules.title: Remote code reference
rules.summary: A remote script, style or iframe URL is referenced from extension code or pages.
rules.whyItMatters: Loading code from the network is restricted by Chrome Web Store policy and makes installed behavior non-deterministic.
rules.recommendation: Verify whether these references are documentation links, or actual runtime loads.

rules.title: External message handlers present
rules.summary: The extension registers externally reachable message handlers (onMessageExternal / onConnectExternal or externally_connectable).
rules.whyItMatters: Websites or other extensions may be able to invoke functionality in this extension.
rules.recommendation: Check that handlers validate senders and do not expose privileged actions.

rules.title: Potential secret-like value detected
rules.summary: A string resembling an API key, token or private key was found in the package. Value redacted.
rules.whyItMatters: Embedded secrets can be extracted by anyone with access to the package and may grant access to external services.
rules.recommendation: If this is a real credential, treat it as compromised. It may also be a test value or false positive.

rules.title: Web-accessible executable resources
rules.summary: Scripts are exposed to web pages via web_accessible_resources.
rules.whyItMatters: Exposed scripts can be retrieved by websites, sometimes enabling fingerprinting of the extension.
rules.recommendation: Exposure is not automatically a vulnerability; verify the scope of matches.

rules.title: Relaxed Content Security Policy
rules.summary: The manifest declares CSP directives beyond the MV3 defaults.
rules.whyItMatters: Looser CSP can permit remote or inline content in extension contexts.
rules.recommendation: Review the declared CSP against Chrome's MV3 minimum policy.

rules.title: Browsing activity access
rules.summary: Permissions allow reading browsing history, open tabs or visited URLs.
rules.whyItMatters: The extension can observe the user's browsing activity.
rules.recommendation: Confirm this capability matches the extension's purpose.

rules.title: Cookie access
rules.summary: The extension can read cookies for permitted hosts.
rules.whyItMatters: Cookies can contain session identifiers for websites the user is logged into.
rules.recommendation: Confirm cookie access is required for the extension's purpose.

rules.title: Analytics or tracking endpoints referenced
rules.summary: Code references endpoints commonly used for analytics, advertising or crash reporting.
rules.whyItMatters: Usage data may be transmitted to third parties.
rules.recommendation: Review the extension's privacy policy regarding telemetry.

rules.title: Clipboard access
rules.summary: The extension can read or write the clipboard.
rules.whyItMatters: Clipboard content can include passwords and other sensitive material.
rules.recommendation: Confirm clipboard access fits the extension's purpose.

rules.title: Broad website access combined with content injection
rules.summary: Broad host permissions coexist with content scripts matching many sites.
rules.whyItMatters: The extension can read and modify content across the sites the user visits.
rules.recommendation: This does not prove misuse; it defines the extension's reach. Review whether that reach is expected.

rules.title: Small-interval timers
rules.summary: setInterval/setTimeout calls with very small delays were detected.
rules.whyItMatters: Frequent timers can keep pages or the service worker busy.
rules.recommendation: Potential performance concern; verify necessity. Static analysis cannot measure actual CPU use.

rules.title: Broad MutationObserver usage
rules.summary: A MutationObserver appears to watch a large part of the document with subtree observation.
rules.whyItMatters: Large document observers can increase work on dynamic pages.
rules.recommendation: Review whether the observer scope can be narrowed.

rules.title: Potential polling pattern
rules.summary: Repeated timer or storage polling patterns were detected in background or content code.
rules.whyItMatters: Polling can accumulate background work even when idle.
rules.recommendation: Verify whether event-driven alternatives exist.

rules.title: Repeated full-DOM queries
rules.summary: querySelectorAll/document-wide queries appear repeatedly in loop-like patterns.
rules.whyItMatters: Repeated large DOM scans can add up on complex pages.
rules.recommendation: Potential performance concern; verify with profiling if slowdowns are observed.

rules.title: Large content script bundle
rules.summary: One or more content scripts are unusually large.
rules.whyItMatters: Large injected scripts add parse and execution work on matching pages.
rules.recommendation: Contextual signal only; compare with other installed extensions.

rules.title: Large package size
rules.summary: The extension package is among the larger installed packages.
rules.whyItMatters: Size affects install and update time and may indicate bundled duplicates.
rules.recommendation: Informational, relative to your other installed extensions.

rules.title: Duplicate dependency copies
rules.summary: Multiple copies or versions of the same library appear to be bundled.
rules.whyItMatters: Duplicated libraries increase package size and can cause subtle version conflicts.
rules.recommendation: Possible package bloat; informational.

rules.title: Files skipped during analysis
rules.summary: Some files exceeded configured analysis size limits.
rules.whyItMatters: Findings coverage is incomplete for the affected files.
rules.recommendation: Raise limits in settings if full coverage is required.

rules.title: Low source readability
rules.summary: The JavaScript is heavily minified or bundled without source maps.
rules.whyItMatters: Low readability affects the confidence of static audits of this extension.
rules.recommendation: Manual review may be needed for high-assurance decisions.

rules.title: Obfuscation indicators
rules.summary: Heuristics suggest the code is deliberately difficult to analyze.
rules.whyItMatters: Obfuscation is used by both legitimate commercial software and unwanted software; it lowers audit confidence.
rules.recommendation: Code is difficult to analyze. Manual review recommended. This is not evidence of maliciousness.

rules.title: Manifest V2 extension
rules.summary: The extension uses Manifest V2, which Chrome has deprecated and is phasing out.
rules.whyItMatters: MV2 extensions are disabled or removed in current Chrome versions.
rules.recommendation: Expect this extension to stop working; look for an MV3 update from the publisher.

rules.title: Legacy background architecture
rules.summary: A persistent background page or background scripts are used (MV2 pattern).
rules.whyItMatters: Current Chrome requires service workers for MV3 extensions.
rules.recommendation: Compatibility concern for current Chrome versions.

rules.title: Deprecated or removed API usage
rules.summary: The code references Chrome APIs that are deprecated or removed.
rules.whyItMatters: Calls may silently fail in current Chrome.
rules.recommendation: Verify the extension still functions; publishers should migrate to replacement APIs.

rules.title: Obsolete manifest fields
rules.summary: The manifest contains fields that are obsolete or unrecognized.
rules.whyItMatters: Unknown or obsolete fields may indicate an outdated package.
rules.recommendation: Informational for audit purposes.

rules.title: Malformed manifest
rules.summary: manifest.json could not be parsed as valid JSON.
rules.whyItMatters: Chrome may refuse to load the extension or may be running with partial data.
rules.recommendation: The package appears damaged or non-standard.

rules.title: Referenced file missing
rules.summary: A file referenced by the manifest was not found in the package.
rules.whyItMatters: Broken resource paths indicate a damaged or hand-modified package.
rules.recommendation: The extension may be partially non-functional.

rules.title: Maintenance cannot be determined locally
rules.summary: No local signal reliably indicates whether this extension is actively maintained.
rules.whyItMatters: Unmaintained extensions stop receiving security fixes.
rules.recommendation: Check the Chrome Web Store listing if online information is acceptable to you.

rules.title: Developer/unpacked installation
rules.summary: The extension is loaded unpacked (developer mode) or from outside the Web Store.
rules.whyItMatters: Out-of-store installs do not receive automatic updates or review.
rules.recommendation: Verify the origin of this installation.

rules.title: Communicates with third-party endpoints
rules.summary: Static references to non-first-party network destinations were found.
rules.whyItMatters: Data may flow to domains other than the publisher's own.
rules.recommendation: Review which classifications apply (CDN, analytics, etc.). Not automatically malicious.

rules.title: Dynamically constructed network destinations
rules.summary: Network calls construct URLs from variables or template strings.
rules.whyItMatters: The full set of destinations cannot be determined statically.
rules.recommendation: Usage could not be determined statically; investigate manually if this matters for your decision.

rules.title: References to raw IP addresses
rules.summary: Code references network destinations by IP address.
rules.whyItMatters: IP-based endpoints bypass domain-based visibility and reputation.
rules.recommendation: Verify the purpose of these endpoints.

rules.title: Scan partially completed for this extension
rules.summary: Some analysis steps failed or were skipped for this extension.
rules.whyItMatters: Findings may be incomplete.
rules.recommendation: See coverage notes for details.
